_doc: Region C6 Larkspur Ridge (x -1536..-512, z 1536..2560): built so Pell's Crossing's west end (the world town pell_outskirts, 32 of its 36 lots here) stands in play (owner report 4: bare town edges). It composes from world data as it did unbuilt: the macro ground, the Larkspur cliffs' world relief, Mill Street West and the west end's streets and lots, conifer forest round them (no detail noise: the lots' heights were fitted to this ground). See docs/REGIONS.md.
